{{Quote|Once you get in look for a slave named Noro, he might be able to help you get to the bunker's lower levels.|[[Kyran Silene]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IE" />}}
'''Noro Bok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bok was captured by the [[Corellian slavers]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:IE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer infiltrated the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Noro Bok agreed to help the spacer to access to the lower levels of the bunker. Thanks to Bok's assistance, the spacer was able to explore all the areas of the bunker and eventually broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> Dozens of CorSec agents quickly moved to the slaver bunker and freed all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Noro Bok]]
Noro Bok was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Noro Bok was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>

His appearance was randomly generated during each server reset, but he consistently appeared as a male. [[Species/Legends|Species]] he could appear as included, but were not necessarily limited to, [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] and [[Bith/Legends|Bith]].<ref name="SWG:IE" />
